## NYA Core 3.1.0

### New Features
- Controller overlay for OBS integration (Xbox, PS4, GameCube, Fight Stick)
- Plugin SDK for custom UI components
- Modular game plugin structure
- Autosplitter ASL files for all supported games
- Twitch raid feature with favorites support
- Practice mode save state sync
- Splits overlay scaling in preview
- Save Organizer with custom folder hierarchy

### Improvements
- Updated preset row button layout
- Custom game delete button styling
- Plugin details loading for custom games
- Splits fill width when resizing horizontally
- Tutorial, language detection, split editing improvements

### Bug Fixes
- Fix duplicate multirun preset creation on download
- Fix playtime tracking not updating
- Fix preset modal not closing when clicking outside
- Fix language auto-detection overriding manual selection
